work_session_id.description: Defaults to the host-stamped current work session. Explicit sessions retain single-session scope unless include_descendants is true.

include_descendants.description: Include only host-proven descendant work sessions. Defaults true for the current implicit session and false for an explicitly selected session.

source_incarnation.description: Required with result_ref; copy the source_incarnation from the original review.

result_ref.description: Exact result reference from a prior review. Use its result_detail_request, which also binds the original work session and source incarnation. Returns bounded retained transcript text, not reconstructed raw output.
